## Code

```cpp
class Solution {
public:
    int largestRectangleArea(vector<int>& arr) {
        int ans=0,n=arr.size();
        for(int i=0; i<n; i++){
            int temp=0;
            int left=i;
            int right=i;

            while(left>=0 && arr[i]<=arr[left]){
                left--;
            };

            while(right<n && arr[i]<=arr[right]){
                right++;
            }
            
            ans=max(ans, arr[i]*(right-left-1));
        }

        
        return ans;
    }
};
```
